Definition: Section: `config_properties`The year and Julian day on which the simulation will end.
Section: `config_properties` Unique 5-digit code that represents a specific US county.
Section: `animal_properties` Number of milkings (per day). The average or most common number of times cows are milked per day (1, 2, or 3 times daily)
Section: `animal_properties` Fractions of the milking animal population that are parity 1, 2, and 3 and beyong. The sum of these fractions must be 1.0.
Section: `animal_properties` The total milk yield generated by the farm in one year (kg). If this information is not available, it can be input as null.
Section: `lactation_properties` Fraction of cows assumed to be in milk at any given time.
